title: 05 bypass receipt, https://use05.dev/bypass/v0
description: An in-toto Statement v1 saying a person overrode a block for one exact tree, for a stated reason (break glass); or, with env, from and rule, one rule of promoting one exact commit into an environment, whose subject is then that commit. Fields are only ever added, as optional ones.

findings.description: What was bypassed, in words, so the audit trail is readable.

env.description: For a promotion's bypass: the environment promoted into.

from.description: For a promotion's bypass: the environment promoted from.

rule.description: For a promotion's bypass: the promotion rule it clears (source_checks, source_confirmed, soak, migrations, untasked or sign_off).

policy_sha256.description: For a promotion's bypass: the policy it was given under; a policy change voids it.
